// diagnostic

E0712

This `#FX` region uses the effect `{effect_name}`, which has no authority backing.

What

This `#FX` region uses the effect `{effect_name}`, which has no authority backing.

Why

`#FX(…)` allows exactly the listed effects; an effect reached inside — even transitively through a call — that the list omits has no authority backing it.

Fix

Add the named effect to the `#FX(…)` list, or move that work outside the region.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0712: tests/ui/crypto_expert_nonce_region_authority_precedence.stderr.

Error [jet.EffectWithoutAuthority]: This `#FX` region uses the effect `FS.Read`, which it has no authority for
  --> tests/ui/crypto_expert_nonce_region_authority_precedence.jet:8:8
    |
  8 |     #FX(Net) {
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: `#FX(…)` allows only `Net`; an effect reached inside — even through a call — must be in that list
 Fix: Add `FS.Read` to the `#FX(…)` list, or move that work outside the region
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: #FX
 Scope chain: #FX
